natural_language_goal: Run repeated PufferLib-gated SP80 level-1 episodes to learn a primitive-action algorithm for catching paintflow and redirecting it to the requested target bucket.
truth_boundary: controlled level-1 mechanics run; PufferLib import-gated but not a native PufferLib trainer; not full CONTRA Angel solve evidence
backend: pufferlib.pufferl import-gated direct SP80 primitive-action mechanics loop

loader_settings.policy_representation: tabular pose-bandit over legal level-1 bar poses; each episode selects one pose, executes bounded primitive moves, activates flow, and updates pose value from pre-reset catch/overflow events
loader_settings.pufferlib_4_0_api_note: The checked-out 4.0 branch does not expose the older Python PufferEnv/vector/emulation APIs; this condition gates on pufferlib.pufferl native import but executes SP80 through the existing Python game/controller API.
